QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] A Request to His Apprentice
QuestInfo.0: Manji, who has received Mu Young's messages, seems to have a favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Manji has asked you to pass along a request to #bMu Young#k in the #eSleepywood Underground Temple#n. Deliver Manji's request to Mu Young the apprentice.
QuestInfo.2: Manji has asked you to pass along a request to Mu Young in Sleepywood Underground Temple. Upon delivery, Mu Young firmed his resolve.
QuestInfo.summary: Find Mu Young in the Sleepywood Underground Temple.

0.0: Mu Young tells me you were a big help. If you happen to head back into Sleepywood, could you let Mu Young I got his message?
0.1: Please tell Mu Young that Balrog is the essence of evil, and that he must never let his guard down. It may seem safe now, but it will never truly be gone.

no.0: Do you have other places to go? Are you going to Ossyria or something?

1.0:
Oh! You're back! Did you give my master the message?

#b#L0#Yup. And Manji also wanted me to tell you something.#l
#k
1.1:
What is it?

#b#L0#He said to stay alert at all times because Balrog is an evil creature.#l
#k
1.2: I will keep that in mind. I'll always remind myself so I don't forget. Thank you so much for coming back to tell me that.

yes.0: I'd love to see you from time to time. I'm going to stay in here and continue with my investigation, but if you're ever nearby, please feel free to visit.

npc.0: Deliver my message to Mu Young in the Sleepywood Underground Temple.
